data.raw_text: Iranian authorities are now allowing increasingly more ships & "friendly" nations to cross the #StraitOfHormuz. Vessels from China, Russia, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Iraq, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Egypt & South Korea (plus Oman & Japan in recent transits) are securing safe passage — with Iran collecting tolls in yuan or crypto (up to $2M per ship / ~$1 per barrel).  As negotiations accelerate, expect traffic to ramp up sharply in the coming weeks, more countries joining the deals, and stabilized oil flows under Tehran’s control.
